title: From the Echoes of Destruction

{{Quest Infobox |id = 145000004 |type = Main |nation = Huanglong |region = |area = |event_name = |chapter = Chapter I |actNum = VIII |act = To the Shore's End |part = |characters = Rover;Yangyang;Youhu;Niya;Hoda;Shorekeeper |npc = |description = The future is still unknown, and the past remains buried beneath the waves. After your journey across Mt. Firmament, all clues now point to a hidden island in the sea—the Black Shores. Yangyang's message hints that in the Port City of Guixu, you might find the Bloom Bearer now stationed in Jinzhou. |requirement = |startLocation = |prev = [[Dawn of Snowstorm]] |next = [[Hidden Between the Waves]] |rewards = }} {{Intro/Quest|From the Echoes of Destruction}} ==Summary== [[Yangyang]] has sent word that a Bloom Bearer from the [[Black Shores]] is currently in the [[Port City of Guixu]] and may have important information about your identity. Upon your arrival in the city, you happen to run into [[Chenpi]]'s apprentice, [[Youhu]]...
In the Port City of Guixu, you meet [[Niya]], a Bloom Bearer who quickly recognizes you. She warns of an abnormal frequency detected in Guixu that must be urgently brought back to the Black Shores. If left unresolved, it might trigger another [[The Lament|Lament]]...
Upon arriving at the coordinated provided by Niya, you find the bodies of several Black Shores members who have died under mysterious circumstances. There, you encounter a mysterious Bloom Bearer named [[Hoda]], who claims to know about your past but cannot divulge the details. Before disappearing, Hoda directs you to Youhu for further clues...
Youhu reveals that the clue Honda mentioned is an artifact from Mt. Firmament, discovered by her and Master Chenpi. Now, it seems connected with the Black Shores. The frequency tied to Hoda is hidden within this artifact, and it seems linked to the deaths of the Bloom Bearers. Reporting this matter to Niya and the Black Shores is now a matter of urgency.
As you traverse the Sonoro Sphere, you finally arrive at your true beginnings. Yet, the person who waits here remains beyond your grasp... ==Steps== #Head to the Port City of Guixu and meet with Yangyang #Search for the Black Shores researcher #Head to the designated coordinates #Investigate the abnormal Tacet Discord #Defeat all abnormal TDs: (0/5) #Head to the designated coordinates #Investigate the surrounding and report to Niya #Investigate the anomaly under the bridge ==Gameplay Notes== *Completing the second "Head to the designated coordinates" step awards the player {{Item|Model HL-1}}. *Completing the step "Investigate the anomaly under the bridge" will award the player the ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' trophy ''[[Butterfly Across the Sea]]''. ==Dialogue == {{Quest Description|The future is still unknown, and the past remains buried beneath the waves. After your journey across Mt. Firmament, all clues now point to a hidden island in the sea—the Black Shores. Yangyang's message hints that in the Port City of Guixu, you might find the Bloom Bearer now stationed in Jinzhou.}} {{Dialogue Start}} ;(Head to the designated location) :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_2_4.ogg}} '''???:''' Well, well! I'm stuck here monitoring, can't leave my post. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_20.ogg}} '''Niya:''' Do you think you could help check out what happened? :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_21.ogg}} '''Niya:''' If things aren't looking good, we might need to inform Jinzhou's [[Jinzhou City Hall|City Hall]], like we did before. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_22.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We will need to act fast, then. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_37.ogg}} '''Niya:''' That's the worst-case scenario. If we contain the frequency as the Tethys System advises, nothing bad will happen. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_38.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' {{Rover}}, I want to help her. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_39.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' As an Outrider, it's my duty to safeguard the peace. :{{DIcon}} Guess I'll take charge. One thing's for sure though, this frequency represents gravity. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_26.ogg}} '''Niya:''' It's abnormal because... it has its own gravitational center. You should be able to feel a palpable anomaly near it. That's how you can locate it. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_28.ogg}} '''Niya:''' I trust you'll handle it smoothly. But remember, your safety matters most. Don't hesitate to retreat if you run into any real danger. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_29.ogg}} '''Niya:''' And once you're back, we'll hurry to the Black Shores to upload it to the Tethys System... Oh! I forgot you haven't been to the Black Shores, have you? :{{DIcon}} Not yet, at least. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3_31.ogg}} '''Niya:''' No worries. I'll be your guide then. ---- ;(Optional - Talk to the Blurred Figure) :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3001_1.ogg}} '''Blurred Figure:''' The new ''Final Fancy Defense'' comes out tomorrow. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3001_2.ogg}} '''Blurred Figure:''' Ugh, still have to wait a week to get my shell credits... ---- ;(Optional - Talk to the Blurred Figures) :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3002_1.ogg}} '''Blurred Figure:''' Mommy, when's the next subway? :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_3002_2.ogg}} '''Blurred Figure:''' Oh, sweetheart, it's just ten minutes away.
